title: Hearthstone
notes: Hearthstone is online, so Vault never reads its memory. Achievements come from Hearthstone's own game log (Power.log), the same one Hearthstone Deck Tracker reads.
Vault turns the game log on for you (it adds a [Power] section to Hearthstone's log.config). If Hearthstone was open when you installed or updated Vault, restart it once.
Games played before the log was on can't count. Class wins count from your first logged game.

testGuide.title: Restart Hearthstone
testGuide.detail: Close Hearthstone completely and start it again, so it picks up the game log setting.

testGuide.title: Play one game
testGuide.detail: Any mode works. When it ends, "Games tracked" goes up and the matching achievements pop.
